$comment: Generated by `pnpm gen` from the op registry (packages/ops). Do not edit. Option kind "json" takes any JSON value; a word that is not valid JSON is a string.

commands.summary: Create an animation (group + optional direction) with empty frames of equal duration.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: group
options.description: Animation group, e.g. "run".

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction, e.g. "side" (omit for undirected).

options.name: loop
options.description: "loop" (default), "once" or "pingpong".

options.name: frames
options.description: Number of empty frames (default 1).

options.name: durationMs
options.description: Duration of every frame in ms (default 100).

options.name: angleQuantum
options.description: Rig angle quantum, deg (a multiple of 0.25 that divides 360; default 1).

commands.summary: Rename an animation (group, direction), set its loop mode, angle quantum or post-passes.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: group
options.description: New group name.

options.name: direction
options.description: New direction; null makes it undirected.

options.name: loop
options.description: "loop", "once" or "pingpong".

options.name: angleQuantum
options.description: Rig angle quantum, deg (multiple of 0.25 dividing 360); null restores the default.

options.name: postPasses
options.description: Post-passes after the rig render: {removeOrphans: {}, outline: {color: [r,g,b,a], outsideOnly?, corners?}}; null removes them.

commands.summary: Link a layer's cel to another frame's cel (mode "link"), make a linked cel independent ("unlink"), or link all identical cels ("linkIdentical").

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: layer
options.description: Layer id ("lay_...") or layer name.

options.name: mode
options.description: What to do.

options.name: animation
options.description: link/unlink: animation of the cel. linkIdentical: limits the scan (default: all).

options.name: frame
options.description: link/unlink: the cel's frame.

options.name: source
options.description: link: the frame whose cel is shown.

commands.summary: Create a new empty RGBA document (no layers, no animations) and open it. Save it with doc_save.

options.name: name
options.description: Display name (default "untitled").

options.name: width
options.description: Canvas width, int px.

options.name: height
options.description: Canvas height, int px.

options.name: origin
options.description: Origin pixel on the canvas, int px (default: bottom-centre).

options.name: pixelsPerUnit
options.description: Pixels per engine unit (default 16).

options.name: idSeed
options.description: Seed of the id generator (default: derived from the host clock).

commands.summary: Open a .pxf file and return its document id, which every other op takes as "doc".

options.name: path
options.description: Path of the .pxf file (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

commands.summary: Redo the newest undone change of the document (one history entry).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

commands.summary: Save the document to its .pxf file, or to a new path (first save, save as).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: path
options.description: Target .pxf path (absolute, inside the workspace roots). Default: the current path.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing file at a new path (default false).

commands.summary: Switch the document between "rgba" and "indexed" pixels, and/or lock it to its palette.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: colorMode
options.description: "rgba" or "indexed" (default: unchanged).

options.name: paletteLocked
options.description: Lock colours to the active palette (default: unchanged).

commands.summary: Summarise an open document: canvas, palette, layers, rig (bones, parts, views) and animations.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

commands.summary: Undo the newest applied change of the document (one history entry).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

commands.summary: Insert an empty frame before or after a frame; the new frame gets no bone or part keys.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Reference frame: the new frame goes next to it.

options.name: position
options.description: "after" (default) inserts behind the reference frame, "before" in front of it.

options.name: durationMs
options.description: Duration of the new frame in ms (default: the reference frame duration).

commands.summary: Delete one frame with its bone and part keys, cels and overrides; the last frame cannot go.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

commands.summary: Duplicate one frame; the copy goes right after it, with linked cels and copied keys.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

commands.summary: Set one frame's duration (ms), markers (name -> int px), events (names) and root motion (int px).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: durationMs
options.description: Frame duration, ms.

options.name: markers
options.description: Markers by name, canvas px (e.g. "hand_r": {"x": 30, "y": 20}); null removes one.

options.name: events
options.description: Event names fired on this frame; replaces the list.

options.name: rootMotion
options.description: Root motion of this frame, int px.

commands.summary: Export animations as a spritesheet PNG plus a JSON description (Aseprite hash format).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: path
options.description: Output PNG path (absolute, inside the workspace roots); the JSON goes beside it.

options.name: animations
options.description: Animations to export, in order (default: all).

options.name: layout
options.description: "rows" (default) or "packed".

options.name: scale
options.description: Integer scale, 1..16 (default 1).

options.name: skin
options.description: Skin name, or "base" (default).

options.name: exportOnly
options.description: Only layers with export: true (default true).

commands.summary: Import a PNG spritesheet (cells per animation) or an .aseprite file into a document.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: file
options.description: Path of the file (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

options.name: format
options.description: Default: from the file extension.

options.name: cell
options.description: spritesheet: cell size [w, h] px (default: the whole image is one cell).

options.name: animations
options.description: spritesheet: the animations to cut (required for a spritesheet).

options.name: outlineFile
options.description: spritesheet: matching outline sheet, same size.

options.name: layerName
options.description: spritesheet: layer for the cels (default "body"; reused if it exists).

options.name: outlineLayerName
options.description: spritesheet: layer of the outline sheet (default "outline").

options.name: defaultDurationMs
options.description: spritesheet: frame duration when an animation gives none (default 100).

options.name: reimport
options.description: aseprite: update a file imported earlier instead of adding (default false).

options.name: view
options.description: aseprite: rig view for "part:" layers without #view (default: the first).

options.name: paletteName
options.description: aseprite: name of the imported palette.

commands.summary: Rename a layer, or set its visible flag, opacity (0..255) or export flag.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: layer
options.description: Layer id ("lay_...") or layer name.

options.name: name
options.description: New layer name.

options.name: visible
options.description: Show or hide the layer in the editor render.

options.name: opacity
options.description: Layer opacity, 0..255.

options.name: export
options.description: Include the layer in exports and bakes.

commands.summary: Check the document and list findings (palette, orphan pixels, joint gaps, stale overrides, empty frames).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: enable
options.description: Run only these rule ids (default: all).

options.name: disable
options.description: Skip these rule ids (applied after enable).

options.name: animations
options.description: Animations to render and check (default: all, in document order).

options.name: skins
options.description: Skin names to render for palette checks; "base" is the base colours (default: base, then every skin).

options.name: maxPixels
options.description: Most pixels listed per finding (default 16).

commands.summary: Import an edited PNG of a rig frame: the pixels that differ from the render become overrides.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: file
options.description: The edited PNG (absolute, inside the workspace roots), canvas size, scale 1.

commands.summary: List overrides: stale ones (art under them changed) and ones that fail to render, apart.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animations
options.description: Only these animations (default: all).

commands.summary: Resolve overrides: "keep" them, "rebase" onto the current art, or "discard" them.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: action
options.description: What to do with them.

options.name: overrides
options.description: Override ids ("ovr_...").

options.name: allStale
options.description: Also include every stale override of the document (default false).

commands.summary: Close joint gaps by painting hidden overlap on the part drawn lower; the rest composite stays the same.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: view
options.description: Rig view to check (default: the first view).

options.name: bones
options.description: Only joints whose child bone is one of these (default: all joints with gaps).

options.name: color
options.description: Paint colour: [r,g,b,a], or a palette index in an indexed document.

commands.summary: Paint a text grid into a part variant's own image.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: part
options.description: Part: its part-layer name (e.g. "head"), part id ("prt_...") or layer id.

options.name: variant
options.description: Variant name (e.g. "default", "sleeve") or id ("var_...").

options.name: x
options.description: Column of the grid in the variant image (default 0).

options.name: y
options.description: Row (default 0).

options.name: rows
options.description: Equal-length rows, at most 32x32 symbols.

options.name: legend
options.description: Symbol (0-9A-Za-z) to "#rrggbb[aa]".

commands.summary: Split a region (rect, lasso or flood) of a flat layer's cel into a new layer bound to a bone.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: layer
options.description: The flat pixel layer to cut from (id or name).

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: The frame whose cel is cut.

options.name: selection
options.description: The region to cut.

options.name: partName
options.description: Bind as "part:<bone>[.<part>][@variant][#view]" or a bone name.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the new layer while it is not a part (default "split").

options.name: bind
options.description: Without partName: try to bind by overlap (default true).

options.name: view
options.description: View for names without #view and for overlap (default: the first).

options.name: zByBone
options.description: Default z of the new part by part-layer name, then bone name; higher draws on top. Set at creation; change later with rig_set_part_z.

commands.summary: Read a region (at most 64x64 px) of a frame as a text grid: one symbol per pixel, "." transparent, with a legend of the colours present.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: layer
options.description: Read this pixel layer's cel instead of the rendered frame (mirror animations: not allowed).

options.name: x
options.description: Left column of the region, canvas px (default 0).

options.name: y
options.description: Top row of the region, canvas px (default 0).

options.name: width
options.description: Region width, 1..64 px (default: to the right edge, if at most 64).

options.name: height
options.description: Region height, 1..64 px (default: to the bottom edge, if at most 64).

options.name: rulers
options.description: Also return `ruled`: the rows with column and row numbers (default false).

commands.summary: Paint a text grid (at most 32x32 px) at (x, y) of a frame; symbols come from "legend".

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: layer
options.description: Pixel layer whose cel to write. Omit on a rig frame (the rendered frame is edited into overrides), or when the document has exactly one pixel layer.

options.name: x
options.description: Canvas column of the grid's left edge (default 0).

options.name: y
options.description: Canvas row of the grid's top edge (default 0).

options.name: rows
options.description: Pixel rows, at most 32 rows of at most 32 equally long symbols: "." transparent, "_" keep, 0-9A-Za-z from the legend.

options.name: legend
options.description: Symbol (one of 0-9A-Za-z) to colour "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa". Only symbols used in `rows` need an entry.

commands.summary: Build a .pxf from a .pxfd folder (the inverse of pxf_unpack).

options.name: dir
options.description: The .pxfd folder (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

options.name: file
options.description: The .pxf to write, named *.pxf (default: beside the folder).

commands.summary: Expand a .pxf into a .pxfd folder (manifest, document, images, render cache).

options.name: file
options.description: The .pxf to expand (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

options.name: dir
options.description: Folder to create, named *.pxfd (default: beside the file).

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing folder (default false).

commands.summary: Render the frames of some or all animations as one labelled PNG contact sheet (long edge at most 1568 px), optionally with bone lines and pivot markers.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animations
options.description: Animations to show, in order (default: all).

options.name: scale
options.description: Integer upscale to start from, 1..16 (default: the largest that fits 1568 px; reduced until it fits).

options.name: labels
options.description: Write "GROUP/DIRECTION #n" under each frame (default true).

options.name: skin
options.description: Skin name or id ("skn_..."); omit for the base render.

options.name: bones
options.description: Draw a line from each bone pivot to its tip on every tile (default false).

options.name: pivots
options.description: Draw a marker on each bone pivot pixel on every tile (default false).

commands.summary: Render one frame to an upscaled PNG on a checkerboard (long edge at most 1568 px), optionally with bone lines and pivot markers.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: scale
options.description: Integer upscale 1..16 (default and maximum: the largest that keeps the long edge within 1568 px).

options.name: skin
options.description: Skin name or id ("skn_..."); omit for the base render.

options.name: bones
options.description: Draw a line from each bone pivot to its tip (default false).

options.name: pivots
options.description: Draw a marker on each bone pivot pixel (default false).

commands.summary: Apply a humanoid skeleton template: bones matched by name are reused, missing ones are created.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: template
options.description: Skeleton template: humanoid-side, humanoid-front or humanoid-back.

options.name: height
options.description: Character height in px, feet row to top of head (default 48).

options.name: view
options.description: Existing view to set the rest pose in (default: a new view).

options.name: viewName
options.description: Name of the new view (default: the template name, e.g. "side"); ignored with view.

commands.summary: Bake a rig animation into one plain pixel layer: as a new animation, or in place.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: mode
options.description: "new" keeps the source; "replace" bakes it in place.

options.name: name
options.description: mode "new": group of the baked animation (default <group>_baked).

options.name: confirm
options.description: Must be true: this operation is destructive.

commands.summary: Bind pixel layers to bones as parts, by layer name ("part:<bone>[.<part>][@variant][#view]") or by overlap.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: layers
options.description: Only these layers (default: every pixel layer).

options.name: byName
options.description: Bind by layer name (default true).

options.name: byOverlap
options.description: Bind the rest by overlap with the bones (default true).

options.name: rawNames
options.description: Source names to parse instead of layer names, by layer: {"arm": "part:upper_arm_r@open#side"}.

options.name: view
options.description: View for names without #view and for overlap (default: the first).

options.name: zByBone
options.description: Default z of new parts by part-layer name, then bone name; higher draws on top. Set at creation; change later with rig_set_part_z.

commands.summary: Edit the skeleton: add/delete/reparent/rename bones, set length and rest pose per view, add/rename/delete views.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: edits
options.description: Edits, applied in order.

commands.summary: Sweep each joint of one rig view and report the pixel gaps that open on the outer side of a bend.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: view
options.description: Rig view to check (default: the first view).

options.name: rangeDeg
options.description: Sweep range, degrees either side of rest.

options.name: stepDeg
options.description: Sweep step, degrees.

options.name: radius
options.description: Window radius of the check, px.

commands.summary: Add a mirror of an animation under a new direction: same group, flipped around the origin.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: source
options.description: The animation to mirror (an authored one, not itself a mirror).

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction of the mirror, e.g. "left" for a "right" source.

commands.summary: Read one frame: bone and part values, and which are real keys (the rest are interpolated or held).

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

commands.summary: Set a part's default z (draw order) after creation.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: part
options.description: Part: its part-layer name (e.g. "head"), part id ("prt_...") or layer id.

options.name: z
options.description: New default z.

options.name: view
options.description: View (default: the first).

commands.summary: Set a part variant's pivot: the pixel (int px, in the variant image) that sits on the bone pivot.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: part
options.description: Part: its part-layer name (e.g. "head"), part id ("prt_...") or layer id.

options.name: variant
options.description: Variant name or id (default "default").

options.name: view
options.description: Resolve the variant name among this view's variants.

options.name: pivot
options.description: New pivot, int px in the variant image.

commands.summary: Set bone keys (angle deg clockwise, offset int px) and/or part keys (variant, z, visible) on one frame or many.

options.name: doc
options.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_create.

options.name: animation
options.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

options.name: frame
options.description: Frame: 0-based index or frame id ("frm_...").

options.name: bones
options.description: Bone keys by bone name (or id); null removes the key.

options.name: parts
options.description: Part keys by part-layer name (or part id); null removes the key.

options.name: frames
options.description: Many frames, instead of frame.

options.name: keyAll
options.description: Also key all other bones at rest on posed frames.
